question: How is lane width measured for athletes on a standard synthetic track for races up to 400 metres?

options.text: 1.22 to 1.25 metres wide with 5 cm markings
Variable width based on track length

solution:
The correct answer is __**1.22 to 1.25 metres wide with 5 cm markings**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **standard lane width** for athletes on a synthetic track, as per international regulations, is **1.22 to 1.25 metres**. These precise measurements ensure uniformity in tracks worldwide.
